articles.title: The New ACOTAR Books Are Buy 2, Get 1 Free at Target Ahead of Their Release Dates
articles.summary: Sarah J. Maas announced two new books in her popular A Court of Thorns and Roses series earlier this year. Books six and seven are set for back-to-back releases in October 2026 and January 2027.
body: The next book in the series, A Court of Splintered Harmony, arrives more than five years after the last release. The new book will focus on the Valkyries and expand upon the best selling romantasy book series that Maas has been able to create.

Target's buy 2, get 1 free book sale is currently set to end on October 10, but it's unclear how long these preorders will be included. Amazon has a similar competing sale going on and has been regularly removing some of the best deals throughout its Prime Big Deal Days event. As of right now, though, this is by far the best deal we've seen on the new ACOTAR books. In addition to discounts on the hardcovers and the BOGO promotion, Target also offers exclusive gifts with each book you won't find anywhere else.

As for how this sale actually works, all you need to do is add three eligible items to your cart and Target will automatically discount the price of the cheapest one at checkout. It is a buy 2, get 1 free sale so even if you preorder both books you will need to add something else to take advantage of that discount.

Books six and seven are set for back-to-back releases in October 2026 and January 2027.

articles.title: Sonic Racing: Crossworlds Drops to Its Lowest Price of $20 in Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days Sale
articles.summary: Today is the final day of Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days sale, meaning it's your last chance to save on one of our top video game deals from it: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X has dropped to just $20 at the retailer for Prime members.
body: This marks a return to the lowest price point for each version at Amazon, which is a total bargain if you've been hoping to buy it. The Nintendo Switch 2 version is also on sale right now, though for $10 more at $29.99. If you don't mind that, it's well worth grabbing while it's still available, which won't be much longer.

Since the Prime Big Deal Days sale ends after today, the clock is really ticking to grab these copies on sale. We may not see these discounts pop up again until Black Friday/Cyber Monday, so it's really your last chance before holiday sale events start up at the end of November.

And while a price drop like this is certainly appealing if you've been holding off on buying the game, in general, it seems well worth the investment. IGN's Jada Griffin had very high praise for it when it launched, writing in her 9/10 review that it "fires on all cylinders with a fantastic roster, excellent courses, and lengthy list of customization options."

Especially if you're hunting down a multiplayer game to have ahead of the holidays, she also writes that there are "plenty of modes that entertained my friends and me for hours," which is great news for upcoming gatherings.

articles.title: Xbox Game Pass Gets Gears Of War: E-Day And These 11 Games In October
articles.summary: It's the start of a new month, and like clockwork, the next batch of Xbox Game Pass titles has been announced for the subscription service. Gears of War: E-Day leads the new arrivals this month, and it'll be joined by a few more big games: Battlefield 6 and Valor Mortis.
body: The headline act is the aforementioned Gears of War: E-Day, a pretty great Xbox console exclusive if you're looking for something gleefully loud, dumb, and violent. Minecraft Dungeons 2 has also just launched, and while it does have a few flaws, it's a lot more ambitious than its predecessor.

Other notable games in this first wave include the day-one release of Echo Weaver, an adventure game where time is your greatest resource, and Forever Ago, another brand-new release focused on redemption as you set off on a single-player road trip adventure.

Rounding out the first wave of games on October 15 are several more day-one titles that cover a wide range of genres. You can shoot the Heeler family--with a camera, you sicko--in the day-one release of Bluey's Happy Snaps, and Chained Beasts is a co-op gladiator roguelike. You'll fight side by side with your comrade in arms and chains.
Finally, you can build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist with it as you explore the cosmos in the day-one release of Beyond These Stars.
points: It's the start of a new month, and like clockwork, the next batch of Xbox Game Pass titles has been announced for the subscription service.
Gears of War: E-Day leads the new arrivals this month, and it'll be joined by a few more big games: Battlefield 6 and Valor Mortis.

articles.title: FBI Arrests 29-Year-Old Alabama Man After Epic Reported Fortnite Voice Chat Threats
articles.summary: The FBI arrested a Fortnite player last week after Epic reported threats he made over voice chat. Epic reported Edward Frith, an avid Fortnite player from Alabama, over alarming messages spoken while playing Fortnite. He was later arrested when the FBI turned up at his house.
body: According to the affidavit (reported by Aftermath ), Frith, who went by the username “WagesOfNinja,” said he was letting all his rage out because he wanted to “literally murder somebody” and that he thinks about killing “every day.”

"Let's see if the FBI is going to show up at my door because I'll shoot them motherf****rs too," Frith said, before the FBI showed up at his door. Frith’s other comments were just as disturbing, with the Fortnite player suggesting he was planning to end his life by charging at police.

Epic made what was described as a "voluntary emergency disclosure" to the FBI National Threat Operations Section (NTOS) Exigent Threat Research and Analysis Crisis Team (EXTRACT), relating to the statements. The developer then provided the FBI with an audio recording and transcript of the threats.

The Alabama resident was indicted for violating Interstate Threatening Communications on September 23. He was remanded into custody while awaiting a trial, after entering a plea of “not guilty” on September 24.

articles.title: Pokémon TCG: Phantasmal Flames Booster Bundles In Stock on Amazon at Market Price
articles.summary: Amazon has added another Phantasmal Flames product to its Pokémon TCG stock list during Prime Day, although this one comes with another rather eye-watering price tag. The Phantasmal Flames Booster Bundle is now available for $89.99 at Amazon, which works out at around $15 per booster pack.
body: TCGplayer currently lists the median price at $90, meaning Amazon has matched that price almost exactly. The current market rate is a little lower at around $84, but once you factor in delivery costs, Amazon's offer could once again prove to be the more convenient option.
Whether that makes $90 for six booster packs any easier to stomach is another question entirely.

Phantasmal Flames remains one of the more sought-after sets in the Mega Evolution era, helped considerably by its selection of valuable chase cards. The set's biggest prize is still Mega Charizard X ex, with several other cards commanding considerably more than the price of a standard booster pack.

So, if you're determined to rip some Phantasmal Flames packs during Prime Day, Amazon at least isn't asking for an outrageous premium compared to the wider market. Just don't expect this one to feel like the bargain of the century.

articles.title: New Details Revealed For GTA 6’s Jason And Lucia, Including “Physical Intimacy”
articles.summary: New information has come to light about GTA 6, and specifically the partnership of its main characters, Jason and Lucia. In GTA 6, they are both partners in crime and lovers, and physical intimacy will be part of the experience, it seems.
body: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said in an interview with IGN that physical intimacy is a "huge part" of a relationship, and that applies to GTA 6. Exactly how this may operate in GTA 6, however, remains a mystery. "It has to be done right," Nelson said.
"Like anything that we do, we have to iterate and try things and iterate on it until we figure out what feels right," he explained.

GTA 6's ESRB rating says the game will have nudity and strong sexual content, and IGN reported that when switching characters, it can switch to Jason's POV while he is naked and in the shower. An international rating for GTA 6 specifically mentions how the game will have "sex scenes."

The GTA series has had its fair share of sex-related controversy. One of gaming’s biggest controversies ever, the Hot Coffee surrounding GTA: San Andreas saw Rockstar owner Take-Two paying out money to settle suits related to a mod in GTA: San Andreas’ PC edition that unlocked an interactive sex minigame.

articles.summary: Just a month after Microsoft said Forza Horizon 6 for PlayStation 5 remained on track to release in 2026, a new report says the game has in fact been delayed to 2027. Reputable leaker billbil-kun said Forza Horizon 6 for PS5 is set for release on January 26, 2027.
body: In September, Microsoft said in a blog post that the PS5 edition of the popular racing game was due for release in 2026, but plans have seemingly changed. Officially, however, Microsoft has yet to communicate any update to the game's PS5 release date.

Forza Horizon 6 was released in May this year for Xbox Series X|S and PC. The game, which is set in Japan, scored rave reviews, including an 8/10 from GameSpot, and PlayStation fans have had to wait for their turn to play.

The last game in the series, Forza Horizon 5, was a huge hit on PlayStation 5. In other Forza news, Microsoft recently announced that Forza developers Turn 10 and Playground are merging to become one unified studio to support and grow the brand going forward.

articles.title: Star Wars Officially Brings Back Ezra and Thrawn for New 2027 Release
articles.summary: While Ezra Bridger was a major part of Ahsoka season 1, he didn't actually appear that much until the season's end. Ahead of the Disney Plus show's second season, the unknown adventures of Ezra will finally be revealed in a new Star Wars story coming next year.
body: As part of its New York Comic Con announcements, Marvel Comics revealed the five-issue limited series Star Wars: Ahsoka — Escape from Thrawn. Dave Filoni, creator of the TV series and president and chief creative officer of Lucasfilm, is providing the story, which will be written by Rodney Barnes with art by Andrea Di Vito.

Witness the unseen story of Ezra Bridger's daring flight from Peridea! Ezra narrowly escaped his exile beyond the known galaxy by stowing away aboard Grand Admiral Thrawn's flagship, but his fight to return home is far from over! Hunted across hyperspace with nowhere to hide, the rebel hero must now evade Captain Enoch, counter the dark magick of the Nightsisters, and outwit the Empire's greatest strategist if he hopes to make it off the Chimaera alive. Based on a story by series creator Dave Filoni, this unseen chapter from Ahsoka is a thrilling companion to the upcoming second season of the hit Disney+ series!

articles.title: The Next Gears Of War Game Probably Won’t Need 7 Years To Cook
articles.summary: After a lengthy hiatus, Gears of War returned this week to Xbox Series X|S and PC with a new adventure set during the cataclysmic events of Emergence Day. For fans of the series, it has been a long wait, as the previous entry in the series, Gears 5, was released all the way back in 2019.
body: So far, The Coalition appears to have been spared the brunt of " Xbox reset " layoffs, but fears remain that the axe might swing their way now that Gears of War: E-Day has launched.

Recent changes at Xbox have seen several studios consolidated under Bethesda and Activision, and even Xbox's high-profile Halo series has not been spared. After being under the remit of Halo Studios for several years, a new team at Activision is now developing the next Halo game, rumored to be a new division within Call of Duty developer Sledgehammer Games.

The future of the Gears of War series likely rests with its commercial performance, but as an Xbox exclusive, there's only so much room for sales before you factor in its availability as a day-one Xbox Game Pass release and its launch during a crowded period on the gaming calendar. Crump sees things differently, believing the true measure of E-Day's success will be its ability to move the needle for Xbox and show what the gaming brand is capable of as it enters a new era, not just sales numbers.

articles.title: Dispatch Is GOTY Eligible at Game Awards for Second Year in a Row
articles.summary: This might be a first: Dispatch, the episodic superhero narrative game, is eligible for all the major categories at The Game Awards for the second year running.
body: Representatives for the developer AdHoc Studio told Polygon that Dispatch 's eligibility for the 2026 awards had been confirmed by TGA owner and host Geoff Keighley. This is despite the fact that all eight episodes of the game's first season were released by Nov. 12, 2025 — before the Nov. 21 eligibility cutoff date for the 2025 awards.

That doesn't mean judges were able to play the whole season in time, however. Voting for nominations at The Game Awards usually takes place earlier in November. In a statement provided via email, AdHoc said, "Last year we were nominated for Best Debut Indie Game even though judges had only played half the season, which was pretty wild and definitely meant a lot to our team." At the time, AdHoc did not provide early copies of episodes to press ahead of their release dates, so jury members were in the midst of the game as nominations were being considered.

articles.title: 12 Years Later, Canceled Kojima Game 'P.T.' Makes A Comeback
articles.summary: Before Xbox snapped up the rights to Hideo Kojima's upcoming horror game, the video game auteur shook up the world with a playable teaser back in 2014. Aptly named P.T., the experience was a short yet pivotal one that defined Hideo Kojima's game development career after his rocky departure from…
body: Since then, fans have remade the experience entirely, or created new games inspired by P.T. Yet the original game in its full glory isn't truly accessible unless you're willing to spend hundreds of dollars on eBay for a system with the game still installed on its hard drive. Thanks to recent advances in the PlayStation homebrew scene, however, the original P.T. is now back and fully playable on PC.
"I made this on my own, in my spare time, because P.T. deserved to keep existing somewhere other than on consoles that still have it installed," says port creator LoreanXavier on GitHub.

Every texture, model, and sound is the same as the original game, but LoreanXavier warns that fans will need to actually own a copy of the game to get the PC version running. Alternatively, fans can use a jailbroken PlayStation 4 console that can run versions of the game hosted online by preservationists.

articles.title: Here are our Xbox Game Pass games for October 2026
articles.summary: Microsoft has revealed the first batch of games coming to Xbox Game Pass this month, though subscribers only have a week left to try the award-winning Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 before it waves goodbye.
body: October's undisputed headliner is one of last year's hottest games, EA's Battlefield 6. The large-scale shooter broke series records when it dropped, selling over 7m copies in three days and instantly topping Steam's best-seller charts. Post-launch updates and a surprisingly-involved Top Gun collab have kept the game chugging into this year too, despite layoffs at Battlefield Studios back in March.

The other highlights include seven all-new games launching into Game Pass straight away. Time-loop metroidvania Echo Weaver, road trip adventure game Forever Ago, co-op survive-em-up Deep Dish Dungeon, first-person soulslike Valor Mortis, cute photography romp Bluey's Happy Snaps, co-op roguelike Chained Beast, and city-builder (on the back of a space whale) Beyond These Stars slot into the service on the same day as their full launches.

But Game Pass giveth and Game Pass taketh away. This month's group of leavers include the widely-acclaimed and hugely-celebrated RPG, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, which debuted on Game Pass early last year. Some personal favorites, like Donut County and Pacific Drive, aren't sticking around either.

articles.summary: With 2026 nearing its end, there's no better time to start thinking about end-of-year awards. We expect some unreleased games, like Grand Theft Auto 6, to be in contention come awards season, but there are other undated games we've had our eyes on too.

"We’ve made so much progress on the game since its 2025 reveal but it needs a little more love and care to ensure its release is as smooth as possible. We’ll let y’all know a more precise date once we have all our ducks in a row," Thunder Lotus said in a statement on Steam. "The team is very impatient to get At Fate’s End in your hands and we promise it’ll be worth the wait!"
All is not lost, however, as you can get a sample of At Fate's End now.

You can download the At Fate's End demo over on Steam. Unlike Spiritfarer, and more in line with Thunder Lotus' other games, At Fate's End will feature exciting combat. You'll duel with swords, but also words as you essentially argue with and debate player character Shan's siblings in battle. Shan wields the God Sword Aesus, and she must take her estranged siblings' swords from them so that she can rule as Princess of Swords.

articles.title: Undead Labs speaks about its split from Xbox, revealing it has to "make some changes" to State of Decay 3 following layoffs
articles.summary: State of Decay studio Undead Labs has spoken out after rebuying its independence and leaving Xbox last month, revealing it has "got to make some changes" to State of Decay 3 because of layoffs it suffered as a result.
body: Studio boss Phillip Holt said this during a wide-ranging conversation with The Game Business, in which he detailed the studio's shifting priorities now it has no "boss" to respond to other than its audience, and while explaining why the co-op zombie survival game seems to have been in development for ages.

"We're pretty close to finishing this game," Holt said. "And there's a lot in it. I think folks that saw us at Gamescom can attest to that. I think our alpha players can attest to that. And obviously, with a significant number of people leaving the company, we've got to make some changes. But I don't think we're dramatically addressing scope in that way."

State of Decay 3 currently has a vague release date of "2027", announced this summer, which allows Undead Labs some scheduling wiggle-room. But the game was originally revealed all the way back in 2020, before slipping out of view for a long time, leading people to wonder about what was going on.

articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's latest DMZ trailers have left players confused about the existence of a PvE-only mode
articles.summary: Call of Duty recently kicked off a week of Modern Warfare 4 DMZ news, which brought us a first look at the "action extraction" mode and some insight into developer Infinity Ward's guiding philosophy.
body: Although more reveals are promised, what's been confirmed so far left one of the biggest questions hanging over DMZ unanswered. Namely, whether the mode is going to offer a PvE-only playlist for those not keen on fighting other players. Dedicated PvE is something that inevitably gets brought up with every new extraction shooter, as we've recently seen with Arc Raiders, Bungie's Marathon, and Escape from Tarkov before that. So, does Modern Warfare 4's DMZ have anything to offer PvE players? Infinity Ward hasn't said, but players picked up on some clues seen in recent trailers.

This all started with episode seven of From the Ward, a behind-the-scenes feature that takes us inside the studio. The focus of that episode was entirely on DMZ and it naturally showed a lot of gameplay. At minute 7:34 into the video, we see the deployment screen with four options. Three of the four are discussed, and have on-screen descriptions - except for Single Squad Mission, which suspiciously has neither.
points: Call of Duty recently kicked off a week of Modern Warfare 4 DMZ news, which brought us a first look at the "action extraction" mode and some insight into developer Infinity Ward's guiding philosophy.

videos.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer DF Tech Review - PS5/Pro/Xbox Series X|S - This One's Special!
body: Star Wars: Galactic Racer demonstrates spectacularly that arcade racing isn't dead - and that maybe open world racing isn't the only way forward for the genre. Authentic to the subject matter, there's super-smooth performance and an interesting utilisation of both Unreal Engine 5 and the host consoles themselves. Developer Fuse Games' Series S version is also intriguing...
Clarification: on further analysis, it is less clear if the PS5 Pro version of the game is using TSR or PSSR.
